content: Long-running agentic sessions re-send full accumulated history at every step, so token cost grows superlinearly with steps; agents commonly run ~15 steps/task and can burn 5-30x the tokens of a single-shot call. Mitigations: prompt caching for static system/tool instructions (50-90% cost cut), sliding-window context with summarization of older turns, RAG/scoped retrieval instead of full-document stuffing, coordinator/specialist sub-agent decomposition returning compressed results, and periodic context resets backed by external durable state (files/db) rather than keeping everything in-context.
